name: Really Simple Testimonials
author: Themeix

sections.description:
Really Simple Testimonials is the ultimate WordPress testimonial plugin for displaying customer reviews and client feedback on your website. Perfect for businesses, agencies, and websites looking to showcase customer testimonials with beautiful slider and grid layouts.

Key Features

  • Multiple Testimonial Layouts: Choose from 5 premium-quality themes including slider and grid options
  • Responsive Design: Fully responsive testimonials that look perfect on all devices – desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Frontend Testimonial Submission: Allow customers to submit testimonials directly from the frontend with customizable form fields
  • Star Ratings Support: Display customer ratings with beautiful star icons and customize rating colors
  • Advanced Slider Controls: Control autoplay speed, navigation arrows, pagination, and infinite loop
  • Customizable Design: Customize fonts, colors, borders, spacing, and alignment to match your brand
  • Social Media Integration: Add social media links to testimonial profiles for enhanced credibility
  • Category Support: Organize testimonials by categories for better management and filtering
  • Shortcode Generator: Easy-to-use shortcode generator for quick integration into any page or post
  • Developer Friendly: Clean code structure with hooks and filters for developers
  • Image Support: Upload and display testimonial author photos with custom border radius options
  • Testimonial Management: Full control over testimonial content, company information, and design
  • Translation Ready: Compatible with WordPress translation plugins for multilingual sites

Why Choose Really Simple Testimonials Plugin?

Looking for the best testimonial plugin for WordPress? Really Simple Testimonials offers everything you need to display customer reviews and client feedback professionally. Our testimonial slider and testimonial carousel features let you create engaging testimonial showcases that build trust and credibility.

Whether you need a simple testimonial grid or an advanced testimonial slider with navigation, this free testimonial plugin delivers premium features without the cost. Perfect for agencies, businesses, and developers who want a reliable WordPress testimonial plugin that’s easy to use yet powerful enough for custom implementations.

Getting Started

  1. Create Testimonials: Go to Testimonials > Add New to create customer testimonials with author info, ratings, and feedback.
  2. Generate Shortcode: Visit Testimonials > Generate Shortcode to configure your testimonial display settings.
  3. Customize Design: Choose from 5 beautiful themes, customize colors, fonts, and spacing.
  4. Add to Pages: Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget.
  5. Enable Frontend Submission: Configure frontend form options to allow customers to submit testimonials.

Credits

Developed by Themeix with over 4 years of continuous improvements based on user feedback and WordPress best practices.

Reviews

Love our testimonial plugin? Please leave a review to help others discover the best WordPress testimonial plugin for displaying customer reviews and client feedback!

Support

Need help with our testimonial plugin? Visit our support forums or check our documentation for detailed guides on creating stunning testimonial displays.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Really Simple Testimonials.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire really-simple-testimonials folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this a free testimonial plugin?

Yes, Really Simple Testimonials is a completely free WordPress testimonial plugin with premium features.

Does this plugin support testimonial sliders and carousels?

Yes, we offer both testimonial slider and testimonial carousel layouts with smooth transitions, autoplay, and navigation controls.

Can customers submit testimonials from the frontend?

Yes, our plugin includes a powerful frontend testimonial submission feature with customizable form fields and captcha protection.

Is the testimonial plugin responsive?

Yes, all testimonial layouts are fully responsive and work perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I customize the testimonial design?

Absolutely! You can customize colors, fonts, borders, spacing, alignment, and more to match your brand identity.

Does this work with page builders?

Yes, you can use our shortcode with any page builder including Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and more.

Can I display customer reviews and star ratings?

Yes, our testimonial plugin supports star ratings with customizable colors and sizes.

Is this testimonial plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is translation ready and compatible with popular WordPress translation plugins like WPML and Polylang.

Does this testimonial plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, you can translate the plugin into any language using standard WordPress translation methods.

Can I add social media links to testimonials?

Yes, you can add social media links to testimonial profiles including Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram.
